470: func (p *LogFormatterParams) collectStack(skip int) []byte {
471: 	buf := new(bytes.Buffer)
472: 	var lines [][]byte
473: 	var lastFile string
474: 	p.stackSkip = skip
475: 	for i := skip; ; i++ {
476: 		pc, file, line, ok := runtime.Caller(i)
